LLM Leaderboard - Comparison of AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, SpaceXAI & others

Comparison and ranking the performance of over 250 AI models (LLMs) across key metrics including intelligence, price, performance and speed (output speed - tokens per second & latency - TTFT), context window & others.

For more details including relating to our methodology, see our FAQs.

LLM API Providers LeaderboardTry it out

Intelligence

Updated

Gemini 4 Carbon (high) and Claude Opus 5.5 (max with fallback) are the highest intelligence models, followed by Claude Opus 5.5 (xhigh with fallback) and GPT-6 Astra (max).

Output Speed

Celeris-1 and K2 Horizon 375B A23B are the fastest models, followed by Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL.

Latency

North Mini Code and Command A+ are the lowest latency models, followed by Nemotron 3 Nano (non-reasoning) and Celeris-1.

Cost per Task

K2 Horizon 375B A23B and Command A+ have the lowest cost per task, followed by GPT-6 Luna (low) and GPT-6 Luna (medium).

Context Window

Llama 4 Scout and GPT-6 Sol (Daybreak Blue, max) support the largest context windows, followed by Muse Wonder (max) and Ling 3.1 Flash 1019.

Gemini 4 Carbon (High) currently ranks #1 on the Artificial Analysis LLM Leaderboard with an Intelligence Index score of 59, out of 77 models ranked.

The top models by Intelligence Index are: 1. Gemini 4 Carbon (High) (59), 2. Claude Opus 5.5 (Max, Default Fallback) (58), 3. Claude Opus 5.5 (Xhigh, Default Fallback) (57), 4. GPT-6 Astra (Max) (57), 5. GPT-6 Astra (Xhigh) (55).

Celeris-1 is the fastest at 1,658.0 tokens per second, followed by K2 Horizon 375B A23B (929.5 t/s) and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (456.2 t/s).

K2 Horizon 375B A23B has the lowest cost per Intelligence Index task at $0.00, followed by Command A+ ($0.00) and GPT-6 Luna (Low) ($0.01).

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (Max) is the highest-ranked open weights model with an Intelligence Index score of 32. There are 21 open weights models out of 77 total on the leaderboard.

The top open weights models by Intelligence Index are: 1. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (Max) (32), 2. GLM-5.3 (Max) (32), 3. MiMo-V2.6-Pro (30).

Gemini 4 Carbon (High) leads among 75 reasoning models with an Intelligence Index score of 59. Reasoning models use extended thinking to solve complex problems before responding.
